summary.text: Jamie Flick is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 83, which he has represented since December 2022, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
His career experience includes owning a business.

paragraphs.text: Flick graduated from Jersey Shore Area High School in 1979 and earned a degree from the Pennsylvania College of Technology in 1981.
In the 2023-2024 session Flick was assigned to the Children & Youth, Government Oversight, and Human Services committees.
